summary: The Cost Derivation Engine implementation meets the design intent for all critical requirements. Core functionality—append-only cost ledger, self-healing derivation, budget enforcement, and multi-source collection—is fully implemented and operational. All 52 unit tests pass.

suites.name: test_budget_enforcement_integration.py
suites.coverage: Budget pause, Phase 0, idempotency, limit raise

FR-1_CostEntry_Table.notes: Append-only ledger with all specified columns and indexes

FR-2_SessionCostCheckpoint.notes: Keyed by session_id (not Agent.id) to prevent double-counting

FR-3_Denormalized_Rollup_Columns.notes: cost_total_usd on Task, Feature, Workflow, AutopilotDesign, AutopilotProject

FR-5_Budget_Enforcement_Schema.notes: cost_limit_usd on AutopilotProject, nullable (None = no limit)

FR-7_Generalized_paused_by_Guards.notes: Three guards use 'is not None', start() keeps '== user' (deliberate)

FR-8_Pi_Extension_Collector.notes: JSONL tailing fallback works correctly. Extension is optimization, not requirement.

FR-9_CLI_Transcript_Collectors.notes: Pi, Claude Code (with price table), OpenCode, Codex stub

FR-10_Backend_OpenRouter_Direct.notes: _invoke_and_record wraps all 9 call sites, usage.include=true enabled

FR-11_Claude_Code_Session_ID.notes: UUID5 derivation from deterministic inputs, --session-id passed

FR-12_UI_Budget_Configuration.notes: Display only (cost_total_usd, over budget warning). No input field for cost_limit_usd.

FR-13_UI_Cost_Display.notes: Budget pause badge implemented. Cost shown in project list. Feature/design card display partial.

NFR-2_Data_Integrity.notes: Append-only ledger, self-healing derivation, checkpoint mechanism, raw_usage preserved

NFR-3_Concurrent_Safety.notes: Idempotent budget pause, SQLite transaction isolation, up to 4 parallel features

NFR-4_Maintainability.notes: Mirrors status_derivation.py pattern, abstract base class for collectors, clear separation

NFR-5_Security.notes: Path traversal protection, input validation, source validation

integration_validation.autopilot_api_notes: Some queries still use hardcoded definition_id == 'autopilot' instead of DESIGN_WORKFLOW_DEFINITION_IDS constant

unmet_requirements.name: Pi Extension Collector
unmet_requirements.reason: Not implemented. JSONL tailing fallback works correctly. Extension is optimization for real-time TUI display.
unmet_requirements.impact: No functional impact. Pi sessions still tracked via JSONL tailing.

unmet_requirements.name: UI Budget Configuration Input
unmet_requirements.reason: No input field for cost_limit_usd in ProjectSettingsModal. Display only.
unmet_requirements.impact: Users cannot configure budget limits through UI. Backend API supports it.

unmet_requirements.name: Autopilot API definition_id consistency
unmet_requirements.reason: 5 queries in autopilot_api.py use hardcoded 'autopilot' instead of DESIGN_WORKFLOW_DEFINITION_IDS constant.
unmet_requirements.impact: Some queries may miss Phase 0 workflows. Pattern exists for fixing.

recommendations: Update autopilot_api.py queries to use DESIGN_WORKFLOW_DEFINITION_IDS constant for Phase 0 inclusion
Add cost_limit_usd input field to ProjectSettingsModal.tsx
Consider implementing pi extension for real-time TUI cost display (future enhancement)
Migrate datetime.utcnow() to datetime.now(datetime.UTC) for Python 3.12+ compatibility
Migrate Pydantic V1 validators to V2 field_validator syntax
verdict_rationale: All critical requirements implemented. 52 tests pass (100% pass rate). Minor gaps are non-blocking and can be addressed in follow-up work. Budget enforcement correctly includes Phase 0 workflows. Self-healing derivation prevents data drift. Multi-source collection operational for pi, Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex (stub).
